name: Test (PR & Merge) & Coverage

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]
    paths:
      - '**/*.php'
      - '**/*.inc'
      - 'composer.*'
      - 'package*.json'
      - 'ci/**'
      - 'docker/**'
      - 'tests/**'
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
    paths:
      - '**/*.php'
      - '**/*.inc'
      - 'composer.*'
      - 'package*.json'
      - 'ci/**'
      - 'docker/**'
      - 'tests/**'
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # nightly at 02:00 UTC

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test-pr:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php: [8.4, 8.2]
        db: [mariadb, mysql]
      fail-fast: false
    services:
      db:
        image: ${{ matrix.db == 'mariadb' && 'mariadb:11.8' || 'mysql:8.4' }}
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root
          MYSQL_DATABASE: openemr
        options: >-
          --health-cmd="mysqladmin ping -h localhost -u root -p$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD"
          --health-interval=10s
          --health-timeout=5s
          --health-retries=5
    env:
      DB_HOST: db
      DB_PORT: 3306
      DB_USER: root
      DB_PASSWORD: root
      DB_NAME: openemr
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring,pdo_mysql
          coverage: none
      - name: Cache composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: vendor
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-${{ matrix.php }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: composer install --no-progress --no-suggest --prefer-dist
      - name: Wait for DB
        run: |
          echo "Waiting for $DB_HOST to be ready..."
          until mysqladmin ping -h $DB_HOST -u $DB_USER -p$DB_PASSWORD; do
            sleep 1
          done
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite=unit --log-junit=junit.xml
      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results-${{ matrix.php }}-${{ matrix.db }}
          path: junit.xml

  test-merge:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php: [8.4, 8.3, 8.2, 8.1, 8.0]
        db: [mariadb, mysql]
      fail-fast: false
    services:
      db:

        env:

          --health-interval=10s
          --health-timeout=5s
          --health-retries=5
    env:
      DB_HOST: db
      DB_PORT: 3306
      DB_USER: root
      DB_PASSWORD: root
      DB_NAME: openemr
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring,pdo_mysql
          coverage: xdebug
      - name: Cache composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4

          restore-keys: |

            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: composer install --no-progress --no-suggest --prefer-dist
      - name: Wait for DB
        run: |
          echo "Waiting for $DB_HOST to be ready..."
          until mysqladmin ping -h $DB_HOST -u $DB_USER -p$DB_PASSWORD; do
            sleep 1

        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover=coverage.xml

        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          files: coverage.xml
          flags: ${{ matrix.php }}-${{ matrix.db }}
          name: coverage-${{ matrix.php }}-${{ matrix.db }}

  coverage-scheduled:
